source.inspectionScope: Fresh full69-line patch read, removing seven exact collector names and seven schema labels. Fixed literal absence checked only in MailGlue and metrics; three named UI consumers read to distinguish collection removal from UI-control removal. Existing exact fixed telemetry snapshots reused. No UI runtime or policy-lock behavior test.

text:
commit 6fe572f064a9b8672134ecb09e8a023871dd9c9d
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Apr 8 22:22:21 2025 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Tue Apr 8 22:22:21 2025 +1200

    Bug 1959080 - Stop collecting "disable_button" preferences in telemetry. r=mkmelin
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D244734

diff --git a/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs b/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
index ddf9b27ff76..5d602345e57 100644
--- a/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
+++ b/mail/components/MailGlue.sys.mjs
@@ -1330,7 +1330,6 @@ function reportPreferences() {
     // Connection
     "network.proxy.share_proxy_settings",
     "network.proxy.socks_remote_dns",
-    "pref.advanced.proxies.disable_button.reload",
     "signon.autologin.proxy",
 
     // Offline
@@ -1352,7 +1351,6 @@ function reportPreferences() {
     "mail.spellcheck.inline",
     "mail.warn_on_send_accel_key",
     "msgcompose.default_colors",
-    "pref.ldap.disable_button.edit_directories",
 
     // Send options
     "mailnews.sendformat.auto_downgrade",
@@ -1367,13 +1365,8 @@ function reportPreferences() {
     "mailnews.message_display.disable_remote_image",
     "network.cookie.blockFutureCookies",
     "places.history.enabled",
-    "pref.privacy.disable_button.cookie_exceptions",
-    "pref.privacy.disable_button.view_cookies",
-    "pref.privacy.disable_button.view_passwords",
     "privacy.donottrackheader.enabled",
     "privacy.globalprivacycontrol.enabled",
-    "security.disable_button.openCertManager",
-    "security.disable_button.openDeviceManager",
 
     // Chat
     "messenger.options.getAttentionOnNewMessages",
diff --git a/mail/metrics.yaml b/mail/metrics.yaml
index 3e56c2ed04b..ce720c30531 100644
--- a/mail/metrics.yaml
+++ b/mail/metrics.yaml
@@ -245,11 +245,6 @@ mail:
       - network.proxy.socks_remote_dns
       - offline.autoDetect
       - places.history.enabled
-      - pref.advanced.proxies.disable_button.reload
-      - pref.ldap.disable_button.edit_directories
-      - pref.privacy.disable_button.cookie_exceptions
-      - pref.privacy.disable_button.view_cookies
-      - pref.privacy.disable_button.view_passwords
       - privacy.clearOnShutdown.cache
       - privacy.donottrackheader.enabled
       - purple.conversations.im.send_typing
@@ -257,8 +252,6 @@ mail:
       - purple.logging.log_ims
       - purple.logging.log_system
       - searchintegration.enable
-      - security.disable_button.openCertManager
-      - security.disable_button.openDeviceManager
       - signon.autologin.proxy
       - widget.gtk.overlay-scrollbars.enabled
